segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Thanks for hopping on. Let's run through the launch checklist.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Sounds good. I finished the homepage hero and the pricing section last night.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Nice. Can you send me the revised proposal by Friday?

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Yes, I'll have it over before end of day Friday.

segments.speaker: S3
segments.text: One thing — should we ship without single sign-on for the first release?

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Yes, let's ship v1 without SSO and add it in the next cycle.
